objective: Confirm the exact compact rank-k CPU implementation with fused direct left/right applications against fresh refactorization using multi-seed, exclusive-node, single-thread timing.
compact_backend: fused C++ left recurrence and direct C++ right recurrence without dense transpose/copy passes
timing_order: All six method permutations are repeated equally within every seed/rank/k cell.
timed_region: Prepared mutable state cloning is outside timing. Compact timing includes two triangular solves, rank-k correction, compact factor construction, factor update, and direct left/right operator applications. Fresh timing includes G and M rank-k updates, Cholesky factorization, and complete double-sided rewhitening.
correctness_reference: Fresh FP64 Cholesky factorization and double-sided whitening for the same G+ZZ^T and M+ZW^T.
statistical_unit: One independently generated problem seed; repeat-level timings are summarized within seed and are not pseudoreplicated.
primary_estimand: Within-seed fresh-refactorization median divided by compact-direct rank-k median, summarized across the ten seeds.
stopping_rule: Run every declared rank, k, and seed. Do not tune, filter, stop, or rerun based on confirmation outcomes.

pilot_context.selection_rule: Proceed to a fresh full-grid confirmation only if all correctness checks pass and compact-direct is faster than fresh refactorization on every development seed.
pilot_context.selection_result: passed before this protocol was frozen: all five correctness checks passed and every development-seed fresh/direct median ratio exceeded 1

prior_confirmation.finding_remediated: the former transpose-based compact backend lost only at r=256,k=32
